title: VAST - My Very Polished, In-Depth Space MMO for s&box
author: kurozael
selftext:
**VAST is currently only available on s&box which is available on Steam (** [**https://store.steampowered.com/app/590830/sbox/**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/590830/sbox/) **)**

I'm hoping to release the game standalone on Steam when s&box allows it (hopefully in the next 6 months.)

I've been working on hard on VAST for quite some time now, and it's got extremely good reviews from the players who are enjoying it.

The population within the s&box community is growing, with a lot of returning players. The infrastructure I've built (as a networking programmer for over a decade) will allow up to 2000 players on a single server.

  
AI Tools Used

I've been a programmer for 20 years, but have recently started using a Claude Max subscription for AI assisted development and have found it to be a crazy tool for productivity. I'm getting significantly more done that I ever could have without it.

  
Entire features with tons of depth and integration across all gameplay systems can be concepted, drafted and reviewed in a single day.

**More information at** [**https://vastmmo.com**](https://vastmmo.com)

comments.author: soldiersilent
comments.body: Loving seeing a solid space game. What is your game doing different from EVE online? Is this PVE focused or PVP? Because the copy of the website is very....AI-narrative. But it doesn't actually tell me the game mechanics in a concrete way. It sounds very PVP so why this game versus say EVE?

replies.author: kurozael
replies.body:
My game has various different mechanics that all work together to bring players towards the end-game of Faction PvP and Siege mechanics, Territories and base building. But it also has a bunch of fun PvE content too.

  
One major "selling point" to VAST, and the reason I wanted to make it, is that when it's fully released there will be a server that wipes every 3 months (like Rust but a slightly longer wipe cycle) so players who feel daunted by EVE's long-running economy can really experience that fresh start and race to the top.

I'll still keep a Persistent Universe server for the players who prefer that lifetime progression.

Right now because the population is low and I've not fully released it yet, there are no wipes during the alpha testing period.

replies.author: soldiersilent
replies.body: So the major difference between this and Eve is that VAST is seasonal EVE? Thats an interesting thought for sure. Given the popularity of roguelites/likes its not a bad idea.

replies.author: BooparinoBR
replies.body: There is a comment from Chris Wilson (path of exile creator) mentioning a conversation he had with EVE developers of how envy they were of PoE seasonal scheme which allows PoE to be much more experimental, while EVE has to be much more cautious due to the permanent economy
